dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Continuous and symmetrical bilateral narrowing from the maximum mid-body width toward a pointed posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Median pixel intensity corresponds to a uniform light slate-grey across the visible dorsal plane, distinctly below the reflectance levels of mature white pigmentation.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Gradient between the primary dorsal pigmentation and lateral shading is highly diffuse with no sharp contrast borders.

other_distinctive_markers: A singular, high-contrast dark elliptical aperture is clearly visible on the anterior dorsal midline, representing the blowhole.
